qt: to the Commission Mariusz Kamiński (ECR) Subject:

The Nord Stream gas pipelines made Russia’s aggression against Ukraine possible, becoming a symbol of the Kremlin’s corrupt influence and Europe’s growing dependence on Russian raw materials, while riding roughshod over the principle of European solidarity. Both Poland and the European Parliament repeatedly called for the pipelines never to be put into operation in the first place. Meanwhile, German law enforcement authorities are continuing their international efforts to hold accountable those suspected of involvement in disabling the gas pipelines. It ought to be recalled that a Polish court subjected the German request to extradite a Ukrainian suspect to scathing criticism, calling into question both its legal basis and its merits1. The refusal to grant extradition was branded ‘disgraceful’ by the German investigators. What is truly disgraceful, however, is charging Ukrainians with ‘war crimes’ simply to strip them of combatant immunity, leaving them prey to Russian security services. Instead of seeking to wipe away this disgrace, ensure accountability and permanently sever the political and corruption mechanisms that allowed the pipelines to be built, the German elite are doing the exact opposite. August Hanning, the former head of Germany’s intelligence service (who was detained on espionage charges just this month), has publicly accused Poland of complicity in the sabotage of Nord Stream2. The Bucha atrocities still remain unpunished and Russia is killing thousands of innocent people with its brutal daily attacks waged on Ukrainian civilians and critical infrastructure, including energy facilities. Germany, meanwhile, is fixated on the economic and political lure of restarting Nord Stream. 1.
What specific steps has the Commission taken to guarantee the PERMANENT shutdown of the Nord Stream gas pipelines?
In the Commission’s view, is the German state not infringing the right of Ukrainians to defend their homeland by seeking the imprisonment of the Ukrainian nationals concerned?
